page.overview:
Who is Deirdre Bowman?

Deirdre Bowman is the overprotective mother of Cathy Bowman and the wife of Paul Bowman.

Deirdre first appeared at the very beginning of the picnicking on a beach with both her husband and daughter, Paul and Cathy Bowman. Deirdre wouldn't allow her own daughter to play and have fun on the beach, due to having an irrational fear of snakes. When Cathy was attacked by a pack of Compsognathus, Deirdre screaming in horror just; before the scene cuts away. They sued InGen for Cathy's attack which led to John Hammond being removed as CEO from the company and his nephew Peter Ludlow became CEO. Deirdre and her family is not seen in the rest of the movie; but John Hammond mention that; Cathy had survived the attack.

Deirdre appears to be based on Ellen Bowman, the mother of Tina Bowman, a character from the Jurassic Park novel.

Deirdre Bowman appears as a playable character in LEGO Jurassic World. In the game's retelling of the events of the second film, her daughter's encounter with the Compsognathus is absent and instead the Bowman Family's visit to Isla Sorna is depicted in two still photographs in Hammond's room when Hammond is talking to Ian Malcolm about the incident. In the first photo, Deirdre is sunbathing on their yacht and watches as her daughter catches an octopus with a fishing pole. The second photo depicts Deirdre Bowman with her family feeding a T. rex a hot dog despite a nearby "Do Not Feed" sign.
